mcq.question: Why does the monitor carry the request id in a `contextvars.ContextVar` instead of a global variable?

options.B: Each thread or async task sees its own value, so concurrent requests never mix up their ids

mcq.explanation: Context variables are per-execution-context. A global would be overwritten by whichever request ran last.

mcq.question: What does `RotatingFileHandler(maxBytes=1_000_000, backupCount=3)` do?

options.A: Starts a new file when the current one would exceed ~1 MB, keeping at most 3 old files

mcq.explanation: Old files are renamed `.1`, `.2`, `.3` and the oldest is deleted, so disk use is bounded.
